checkpoints.description: Task 'task-lattice-neurocore-adr' completed successfully.

[1/4] Failing-first test_api.py pins the zero-detail-loss surface: every actual public module symbol re-exported, design aliases resolve, and the neurocore evidence helpers return the repository shapes. [2/4] Implement lattice/api.py as a thin, import-only facade over the existing modules. [3/4] Add README API section, ADR-013 and refresh the codebase map. [4/4] Run the project Phase 4 gates and record the checklist outcome.

impact_assessment.why: ADR-012 is accepted in principle but its Phase 1 lattice-side deliverable does not exist: neurocore cannot import a stable public surface and the proposed design names symbols the package does not expose, so direct backend integration would reach into private modules or fail at import.
impact_assessment.benefits: A single documented import surface gives neurocore and other hosts zero-overhead access to the graph, analysis, synthesis, snapshots, discovery, extraction, ingestion, checks and error contracts without CLI or MCP overhead; the design aliases make the proposed adapter code importable without weakening the existing function-based modules.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds a new public lattice.api module and two helper functions, no existing signature changes; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: import-time only plus read-only helpers; state: no schema or persistence change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: api.py only re-exports existing symbols, so behavior cannot drift; a test compares __all__ against the modules and calls a representative function per family on a temporary database; the two neurocore read helpers are thin filters over build_evidence_matrix and Repository.evidence and are covered by tests; docs and the AST map are regenerated in the same commit.

[1/3] Plan: close the review findings - accept a single string in get_evidence_matrix, re-export every public module symbol including PAPER_FIELDS and MCP/web constants, and enforce the surface with an AST/introspection test; then ADR-014, README, map and gates.

impact_assessment.why: Review found a silent empty result when a single question id string is passed, six public module constants missing from the facade including the adapter's PAPER_FIELDS map, and a subset-only test that let the omissions pass despite ADR-013's no-silent-drift claim.
impact_assessment.benefits: The facade matches its documented contract, host adapters can read the canonical paper field tuple and MCP/web metadata from one import, and a future symbol omission fails a test instead of relying on manual bookkeeping.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: api.__all__ grows and get_evidence_matrix accepts str; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add the failing surface test first, then the one-line input normalization and the missing imports; record ADR-014, update README, refresh the map and run the full Phase 4 gate set.

[1/3] Failing-first tests: get_evidence_matrix accepts one question reference string, rejects empty/non-question bare ids with LatticeError, and an AST inventory asserts every public top-level definition in the surfaced modules is exported. [2/3] Implement input normalization and export the seven missing public definitions. [3/3] Record ADR-014, update the README note, run the Phase 4 gates and complete.

impact_assessment.why: Review found a silent wrong result: passing a single string to get_evidence_matrix iterates its characters and returns an empty matrix, bare ids skip validation, and ADR-013's no-silent-drift claim is not enforced because the test pins only a hardcoded subset.
impact_assessment.benefits: A single reference behaves like a one-item list, malformed selections fail loudly with the Error/Why/Fix triad, and the export inventory now fails whenever a public definition is added to a surfaced module without being exported.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: get_evidence_matrix gains str acceptance and stricter invalid-input errors; dependency: standard library ast/pathlib only; concurrency: tests are read-only; state: no schema or persistence change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalize strings and bare ids through the existing validate_ref rules, add regression tests for each failure mode, and derive the inventory from the module AST so no second hardcoded list can drift.

[1/3] Plan: strict question-ref validation, validate selections before building the matrix, derive the surfaced-module inventory from the package, and correct the evidence-grouping wording; ADR-015 and gates.

impact_assessment.why: Analysis found malformed refs such as q_ and question:q_1:extra still pass the prefix-only check, invalid selections pay for a full matrix build before failing, the inventory module list is hardcoded, and the docstring says grouped by link kind although non-role kinds land in other.
impact_assessment.benefits: Malformed selections fail before any work, the self-checking inventory covers future modules and assignment forms automatically, and the evidence contract is described as implemented.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: get_evidence_matrix validates before building and rejects more malformed values; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing-first tests for the malformed refs and build-order guard, then tighten _question_key, move validation before build, harden the inventory helper, record ADR-015, update README, refresh the map and run the gates.
